parameters.prompt_suite: the six frozen prompts with deterministic repetition to eight requests

execution.cache_semantics: weights warm; per-request recurrent state and KV cache fresh; prefix cache disabled
execution.call_frequency: discovery profile once; candidate screening and qualification require randomized paired repeats
execution.concurrency: separate B=1 and B=8 cases; results are never pooled across cases before reporting
execution.downstream_layout: exactly 64 greedy token IDs per request; TTFT, TPOT, wall time and throughput reported separately
execution.graph_mode: vLLM default torch.compile plus CUDA Graph
execution.upstream_layout: BF16 tokenized natural prompts from benchmark_vllm_offline.py

source_identity.freeze_note: This run formalizes the two workloads already measured on 2026-09-08; prefill and other concurrency levels require separate contracts.
